question: What term describes the delivery of nursing care across a distance using digital technology?
explanation: Tele-nursing is the specific application of nursing duties using telecommunications technology to care for patients remotely. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h1)

question: What is the main difference between tele-health and tele-medicine?

options.A: Tele-medicine includes nursing care while tele-health does not.
options.B: Tele-health is strictly used for emergency surgical procedures.
options.C: Tele-health covers a broader range of services including education and administration.
options.D: Tele-medicine relies on traditional mail rather than electronic devices.

explanation: Think of tele-health as the big umbrella that covers all health services—like patient education and admin work—while tele-medicine focuses specifically on medical diagnosis and treatment. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h1)

question: Which tech allows a patient to send recorded data, like a photo of a rash, for a doctor to check later?
explanation: 'Store-and-forward' means you save the information (like a photo or test result) and send it for a provider to review whenever they have a moment. No live video needed! [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h2)

question: A nurse checks daily blood glucose numbers sent automatically from a patient's smart glucometer at home. What is this called?
explanation: Great job! Remote patient monitoring uses connected home devices to keep an eye on vital signs without the patient needing to visit the clinic. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h2)

question: During a virtual visit, what is one of the main things a tele-nurse does?
explanation: Tele-nurses spend a lot of time listening to patient complaints, checking symptoms, and figuring out how urgently they need care. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h3)

question: A tele-nurse sees that a heart failure patient's daily weight readings are steadily climbing. What should the nurse do next?

options.A: Contact the patient to assess for worsening fluid overload symptoms
options.B: Ignore the data until the patient's next scheduled annual checkup
options.C: Advise the patient to stop taking all prescribed medications immediately
options.D: Delete the readings because home devices are always inaccurate

explanation: Quick thinking! Gaining weight fast in heart failure often means the body is holding onto extra fluid. Calling the patient lets you catch it early before they end up in the hospital. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h3)

question: Which organization sets the rules and scope of practice for nurses right here in Nigeria?

options.D: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria

explanation: That's the NMCN! They guide our training, exams, and professional practice across Nigeria. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h4)

question: Why must a nurse check their license jurisdiction before giving tele-nursing care?

options.A: It guarantees the nurse will receive a higher salary from the government.
options.B: Nurses must be legally authorized to practice in the physical location where the patient is situated.
options.C: Patients prefer nurses who live in foreign countries.
options.D: It ensures the tele-health software will run without internet connection issues.

explanation: Always remember: legally, you can only practice where you hold a valid license to protect your patients and your career. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h4)

question: How can a tele-nurse make sure a patient truly understood instructions given during a video call?

options.A: Ask the patient to repeat the instructions back in their own words.
options.B: Assume understanding if the patient nods once during the video call.
options.C: Send a written legal contract via email for signature.
options.D: Check the patient's medical history for past compliance.

explanation: This is called the 'teach-back' method, and it's a brilliant way to ensure clear communication without making the patient feel tested. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h5)

question: What is most important for a tele-nurse trying to check a patient's skin rash over a video call?

options.A: Adequate lighting in the patient's room
options.C: The brand of the patient's television

explanation: Good lighting is key! Without it, the camera won't show the true color and texture of the skin. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h5)

question: What is one of the biggest challenges to using tele-health in many Nigerian communities?
explanation: Power cuts and poor network signals remain common hurdles that make smooth virtual care tricky in some areas. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h6)

question: What is a major benefit of tele-health for patients living far away from city hospitals?

options.A: Instant physical surgery performed over the internet
options.B: Reduced travel distance and expense to see a specialist
options.C: Guaranteed free smartphones provided by hospitals
options.D: Elimination of all chronic diseases without medication

explanation: Spot on! Tele-health saves patients the stress, time, and transport money of traveling long distances just for a quick consultation. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h6)
